properties.name: app.logging.file.max-size
properties.description: Maximum size of a single application log file before rolling.

properties.name: app.logging.file.max-history
properties.description: Maximum number of rolled application log files to keep.

properties.name: app.logging.file.total-size-cap
properties.description: Total size cap for all retained application log files.

properties.name: app.public-resume-cache.enabled
properties.description: Whether public resume cache is enabled.

properties.name: app.public-resume-cache.backend
properties.description: Public resume cache backend. Supported values are local and redis.

properties.name: app.public-resume-cache.ttl
properties.description: Time to live for cached public resume payloads.

properties.name: app.public-resume-cache.maximum-size
properties.description: Maximum number of public resume payloads retained in local cache.

properties.name: app.security.require-https
properties.description: Whether Spring Security should require HTTPS for all requests.

properties.name: app.security.allow-legacy-plain-passwords
properties.description: Whether non-BCrypt legacy plaintext passwords should be accepted during login migration.

properties.name: app.security.actuator-admin-role
properties.description: Role name, without ROLE_ prefix, required to access non-public actuator endpoints.

properties.name: app.pdf-export.max-profile-characters
properties.description: Maximum profile text characters allowed before PDF export.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.enabled
properties.description: Whether the built-in in-memory API rate limiter is enabled.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.window
properties.description: Fixed time window for API rate limiting.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.login-capacity
properties.description: Allowed login/register requests per client IP and window.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.public-capacity
properties.description: Allowed public resume requests per client IP and window.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.pdf-capacity
properties.description: Allowed PDF export requests per client IP and window.

properties.name: app.rate-limit.api-capacity
properties.description: Allowed authenticated API requests per client IP and window.
